question_en: Return the share of Huawei's TDocs that led to resolutions (effectiveness rate).
original_query: MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution) WITH totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT t) AS resolvedTdocs RETURN totalTdocs, resolvedTdocs, round(100.0 * resolvedTdocs / totalTdocs, 1) AS ratio
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})
WITH DISTINCT t
WITH count(t) AS denominator,
     sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator
RETURN {numerator: numerator, denominator: denominator} AS resolutionLinkedTdocShare

required_fields.name: resolutionLinkedTdocShare
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: exact count(distinct linked Tdoc)/count(distinct all Huawei Tdoc), encoded as an integer numerator/denominator pair

canonical_encoding.denominator: nonzero integer, sign normalized to positive

allowed_equivalent_encodings: typed finite exact JSON number in units of one
explicit percent object with typed finite exact number

rational_share_representation.invalid_candidate_rule: Malformed individual required-field values and nonobject records remain distinct unmatched rows; matching valid rows retain partial score.

rational_share_representation.ordinary_contract_rule: Undeclared contracts use original parser, decoder and scorer without share normalization.
